name: aurora
title: Aurora
description: Curtains of light drawn in Braille glyphs, each with a bright folded edge and rays that fade up into a second colour.

name: beams
title: Beams
description: Shafts of light drawn in glyphs, from a point or an edge, that sweep slowly and fade with distance.

name: contours
title: Contours
description: A topographic map drawn in glyphs: contour lines over slowly drifting hills, with heavier index lines and a light hillshade.

name: eclipse
title: Eclipse
description: An eclipse drawn in glyphs: a dark disc with a hot rim and a corona of streamers that breathes slowly.

name: halftone
title: Halftone
description: A print halftone built from glyphs: round dots on a rotated screen that grow with a noise, radial or linear source, in one ink or up to three.

name: horizon
title: Horizon
description: A planet's horizon seen from space, drawn in glyphs: a lit rim, an aurora glow that drifts along it, and a scatter of stars.

name: mesh-gradient
title: Mesh gradient
description: Three to five colour blobs drawn in glyphs that drift and melt into each other: density follows the blobs, colour blends where they meet.

name: metaballs
title: Metaballs
description: Soft blobs drawn in glyphs that drift, merge and split like a lava lamp, solid with a bright rim or ringed with contour lines.

name: noise-field
title: Noise field
description: A slow, folding noise texture drawn in glyphs, as smoke, ridges, contour lines or marble, with a mask that clears space for text.

name: plasma
title: Plasma
description: Classic demoscene plasma drawn in glyphs: overlapping sine waves that flow into each other while the colour cycles through a palette.

name: retro-grid
title: Retro grid
description: A perspective grid floor drawn in glyphs, scrolling towards a horizon under a slit sun, as on an eighties record sleeve.

name: ridgelines
title: Ridgelines
description: Stacked ridge lines drawn in glyphs, like a pulsar plot: each line hides the ones behind it and the peaks shift slowly.
